## What changes for users?

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include screenshots for visible changes.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, lint, TypeScript and production build pass.
- [ ] Relevant browser flows work on a narrow phone and desktop.
- [ ] Gestures, keyboard navigation, reduced motion and both themes remain usable.
- [ ] Data changes retain sources, confidence, dates and image credits.
- [ ] Security, GitGuardian, CodeRabbit and preview checks are reviewed.
